notes.title: Athena's Revenge Chapter 4 Part 1 (0.6.0)
notes.content:
In chapter 4, Stheno and the others breach the citadel to rescue succubus Queen Eisheth from the demon lord Apep.  Athena makes a deal.

Changes:

 Chapter 4 part 1
 Rerendered several Ashmedai side images to reflect her missing horn
 Additional inner dialog for Aden's perspective in chapter 1
 Clarified steam wishlist 'free' text (demo/public version only)
 Add Spanish translation (initial translation by ktemanuel)
 Add French AI translation
 Add character descriptions to perspective picker
 Add voice effects to chapter 2 Ashmedai scenes (thanks Empress Blue!)
 Update to renpy 8.2.1
 Minor fixes to chapter 3 dialog
 Update gallery with select chapter 4 scenes


Steam Changes:


 New Achievement for playing Aden's Perspective


ELITE Changes:


 Extended Medusa scene


ELITE Version Notes:

This ELITE version contains an extended flashback scene with Medusa that adds to one of the plot points in Euryale's Gambit.  It's just one of several ways this story is starting to complete the trilogy.
